name: 千问
desc: 阿里新一代 AI 助手应用
desc_zh: 阿里新一代 AI 助手应用
solves: Researching, reading pages and building a deck means switching between several tools. 千问 pulls them into a single chat box.
solves_zh: 搜资料、读网页、做 PPT 要在几个工具之间来回切。千问把它们收进一个对话框。
best_for: When you want to look things up and produce a document or slides in the same place.
best_for_zh: 你要一边查资料一边产出文档或演示稿。
notes: 官网已确认；qianwen.com 会 301 跳转至 www.qianwen.com，功能已含 AI 搜索、网页总结、PPT 生成与语音转写
